notes.title: Errors in successive sprints
notes.content: [p]Fixed the bug that the move would sprint continuously[/p][p]If you have any questions, please let us know, thank you![/p]

notes.title: Fixed invalid grids
notes.content: [p]When there is no stamina, the grid file is invalid, and the bug of the false effect file is fixed.[/p]

notes.title: Hide your mouse while playing
notes.content: [p]Pointer fixes the bug that the mouse pointer is not hidden in the game.[/p]

notes.title: Chapter 2 has been added to the demo
notes.content: [p]The demo has added the second chapter of the game content, experience it now![/p]

notes.title: Added block moves
notes.content: [p]Hold off enemy attacks[/p][p]Limited by stamina, will be broken when stamina is depleted[/p][p]Can counterattack at the moment of blocking[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: A Unique Challenge in Custom Campaign
notes.content:
The Custom Campaign offers more additional boss content than regular chapters, and you can define different enemy combinations for endless challenge and fun!
Select "Training Room" on the mission map in the main menu to enter the Custom Campaign.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596339/5a2713a3e1d338c390058ee224a7a1b4aa2cd3bd.png[/img]
Don't get greedy — you can't win!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45596339/8f879d9bb386b9d09859ee30faf04f5c90a192e3.png[/img]

notes.content:
Looking forward to your feedback.
Custom battles in the mission map under the main menu will have more content.
